properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.service-discovery.timeout
properties.description: String representation of Duration of the timeout for calls to service discovery.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.cache.enabled
properties.description: Enables Spring Cloud LoadBalancer caching mechanism.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.retry.avoid-previous-instance
properties.description: Enables wrapping `ServiceInstanceListSupplier` beans with `RetryAwareServiceInstanceListSupplier` if Spring-Retry is in the classpath.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.stats.micrometer.enabled
properties.description: Enables Spring Cloud LoadBalancer Micrometer stats.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.call-get-with-request-on-delegates
properties.description: If this flag is set to `true`, `ServiceInstanceListSupplier#get(Request request)` method will be implemented to call `delegate.get(request)` in classes assignable from `DelegatingServiceInstanceListSupplier` that don't already implement that method, with the exclusion of `CachingServiceInstanceListSupplier` and `HealthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier`, which should be placed in the instance supplier hierarchy directly after the supplier performing instance retrieval over the network, before any request-based filtering is done, `true` by default.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.cache.ttl
properties.description: Time To Live - time counted from writing of the record, after which cache entries are expired, expressed as a `Duration`. The property `String` has to be in keeping with the appropriate syntax as specified in Spring Boot `StringToDurationConverter`.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.health-check.update-results-list
properties.description: Indicates whether the `healthCheckFlux` should emit on each alive `ServiceInstance` that has been retrieved. If set to `false`, the entire alive instances sequence is first collected into a list and only then emitted.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.stats.include-path
properties.description: Indicates whether the `path` should be added to `uri` tag in metrics. When `RestTemplate` is used to execute load-balanced requests with high cardinality paths, setting it to `false` is recommended.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.subset.instance-id
properties.description: Instance id of deterministic subsetting. If not set, `IdUtils#getDefaultInstanceId(org.springframework.core.env.PropertyResolver)` will be used.

properties.name: spring.cloud.loadbalancer.hint
properties.description: Allows setting the value of `hint` that is passed on to the LoadBalancer request and can subsequently be used in `ReactiveLoadBalancer` implementations.
